title: Breaking: The Purge List Is Ready - Mass Firings Are Coming
text:
I’ve warned you for months. I’ve shown you the blueprint. And now the clock is ticking.
Subscribe Share
This isn’t speculation or rumor. My sources — are telling me that Russell Vaught already has a completed “firings list.” It’s ready to be executed. This is the next phase of Project 2025 — a coordinated purge of Democratic programs, staff, and entire federal agencies.
They’re not waiting. They’re not asking. They’re moving.
Meanwhile, the Democratic leadership — the people we should count on to hold the line — are fumbling over themselves. No clear messaging. No unified pushback. While they hesitate, Trump’s team acts. And if we don’t act now, this purge will reshape our government overnight.
I’ve been in the rooms where these deals are drawn up. I know the players. I know the tactics. Here’s what’s happening:
Russell Vaught — Trump’s former budget director and architect of Project 2025 — has a “firings list” in hand.
Stephen Miller’s push — combining immigration crackdowns with deep-state purges — is baked into the plan.
The White House pulpit — and its media allies — are framing this as “reform,” “efficiency,” “draining the swamp,” while preparing to erase entire Democratic-leaning programs and staff.
Speed and secrecy — They believe if they strike quickly, they can break resistance before it forms.
This is not business as usual. This is not a shuffle of a few positions. This is a coordinated plan to dismantle an entire structure of governance.
If this purge succeeds:
Federal programs that millions of Americans rely on will be gutted overnight.
Civil servants and experts will be replaced by ideological loyalists.
The rule of law and institutional checks will erode even faster than we’ve seen.
This is a blueprint for authoritarian control. And it’s happening right in front of us while Democratic leadership is nowhere to be found.
Now is not the time to sit still. Our country is standing on the edge of a precipice — and if we do nothing, everything that we fought so hard to achieve, will be dismantled. This government shutdown, this purge, is not an accident. It’s a coordinated attempt to reframe, to take over our country and dismantle everything we fought to protect.
This is the moment to act. Scream at the top of your lungs. The world needs to know. Every American needs to know the truth. Don’t wait for somebody else to do it — be the microphone. Spread this letter far and wide. Speak out on social media, at your workplace, in your communities. Name the players who planned this purge. Force transparency. Break their silence.
Because every letter I write, every post I publish, I risk everything to bring you the truth — the truth Trump and his allies are desperate to bury. They want to rewrite history while we’re still living it. But I won’t stop speaking truth to power. We don’t have that luxury.
Because every letter I write, every post I publish, I risk everything to bring you the truth — the truth Trump and his allies are desperate to bury. They want to rewrite history while we’re still living it. But I won’t stop speaking truth to power. We don’t have that luxury.
Subscribe Share
Now is the time to act.
But I can’t do this alone.
That’s why I’m asking you — humbly, urgently — to stand with me:
Subscribe to this movement. Become part of this resistance. Bring three or four friends, family, coworkers. Don’t assume they know — make them know.
If you can, become a paid subscriber. I don’t have billionaires or corporate sponsors. I have you. Together we will build this movement and save our democracy.

Trump and his architects of Project 2025 are counting on silence. They’re counting on fear. They’re counting on you giving up.
Let’s prove them wrong.
Stay loud. Stay strong. Stay in this fight.
— Lev Parnas
